statements:
["-- The Tap page renderer does not support a customer gallery section yet.
-- Stop selling the add-on while keeping any historical entitlement records.
UPDATE public.products
SET active = false
WHERE sku = 'addon-gallery' AND active IS DISTINCT FROM false;

-- GOAT has its signature presentation and expanded profile actions, but no
-- gallery renderer. Do not grant or advertise a gallery entitlement.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tier_buttons(p_tier TEXT)
RETURNS TEXT[] LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT CASE lower(COALESCE(p_tier, 'essential'))
    WHEN 'goat'     THEN ARRAY['phone','email','whatsapp','instagram','linkedin','website','location','youtube','links']
    WHEN 'premium'  THEN ARRAY['phone','email','whatsapp','instagram','linkedin','website','location','youtube','links']
    WHEN 'business' THEN ARRAY['phone','email','whatsapp','instagram','linkedin','website']
    ELSE                 ARRAY['phone','email','whatsapp']
  END;
$$;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.tier_buttons(TEXT) TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

"]
